message: Comparator and treatment are both explicit and share the identical raw feature set (lags 1-4, rolls 4/13, yoy=false, no promo/trend/category/clip/window) per the locked machine config, so the log-vs-raw contrast is clean and not confounded by a YoY feature. Statement is falsifiable and matches the estimand (relative WAPE reduction on next-4-week sum, two-way series x origin bootstrap over design B's 32 origins). kills_if has exactly two sole, concrete criteria (CI-vs-SESOI, point-estimate sign) with no qualitative escape hatch. Design B's spacing is internally consistent with A and C (4-week origin spacing), and the compute/power tradeoff vs A and C is justified. Lag/rolling-mean features are backward-looking only, no forward leakage apparent. The config-discrepancy concern in the rationale is correctly routed to the PI for a locked-config correction rather than silently altered here, and the deferred bias-correction/Jensen's-gap follow-up is appropriately kept out of this test's kill criteria since it would change the treatment definition, not just the analysis. No blocking issues. Approved.
new_hypothesis_for_pi: Segment-level bias audit for the naive log-inverse-transform: preregister an ex ante volume-quantile split and a numeric bound on acceptable WAPE degradation in low-volume/sparse series attributable to Jensen's-gap bias, to be tested as a follow-up if PR-LOGTX's aggregate result is positive.
